description: Search and filter the whole project index, the one the site’s assistant reads: the Saudi, captive, GCC, Regional and World Renewables Trackers, Saudi battery storage, the Saudi, GCC, Regional and World Data Centre Trackers, the CCUS tracker, the IEA hydrogen map and the Saudi water, AI and dedicated-systems registers. Filter by free text, place (a country, gcc, mena …), sector, technology, stage or a stage range, commercial operation date range, developer, or one tracker; or pass the /data/projects query string as filter. Returns the matching rows, each with its id, capacity in the unit its source states, stage, country, developers, commercial operation date, its page, its dataset page, the publication it rests on (sourceUrl) and the date it was read (asOf), plus the trackers the rows come from with their own as-of dates. Page with limit and offset. For counts and totals use aggregate_projects, which never sums MWh with MW; for one project’s full facts and every source use get_project. Free with membership, like the project index: it answers a request carrying a member’s API key and refuses one without, except when tracker is global-ccus or iea-hydrogen.

cod.description: Commercial operation date or range, e.g. 2027 or 2026..2028

developer.description: A developer’s company slug, e.g. acwa-power, masdar

filter.description: The /data/projects query string, as the site and its assistant take it, e.g. "place=gcc&tech=solar&stage=construction..operational&cod=2026..2028". The named fields below are added to it.

locale.description: Language of names and labels; default en

place.description: Place slugs, comma-separated: a country (saudi-arabia, uae, oman, qatar, kuwait, bahrain, egypt, morocco, india …), a group (gcc, mena) or a province. A group matches every place within it.

sector.description: renewables, storage, data-centres, hydrogen, ccus, water

stage.description: A stage or a range on the lifecycle ladder, e.g. construction or tendered..operational

text.description: Free text: a project, place or company name (q=)

tracker.description: Only the rows of one tracker: saudi-renewables, saudi-captive-solar, gcc-renewables, regional-renewables, world-renewables, saudi-storage, saudi-data-centres, gcc-data-centres, regional-data-centres, world-data-centres, global-ccus, iea-hydrogen, saudi-water-register, saudi-ai-register, saudi-dedicated-systems

name: find_projects
title: Find projects across every tracker
